P_0x000946.en: Pilot of Cybuster, the <Masoukishin> of Wind. Impulsive and just, a natural athlete, but hopeless with directions. A Japanese youth summoned to the Holy Kingdom of Langran in the underground world <La Gias> to avert a god's prophesied calamity.

P_0x000ADC.en: Only daughter of <DC> leader Bian Zoldark. Superhuman athleticism, reflexes, and eyesight. A pretty but headstrong tomboy, weak to flattery. Loves obscure Japanese period dramas; saving money is her hobby.

P_0x001003.en: Only daughter of Zeoroot Zan Zenosakis, the Langran sword master who took Masaki in; she adored him like a brother, and became his stepsister when Zeoroot adopted him. Mature for her age, with real magical talent. Zeoroot's swordplay is etched into her from years of watching. A fine cook; Japanese dishes learned from Masaki are her specialty.

P_0x0020E3.en: TA Shutedonias soldier. His rank rises and falls in step with his alternating exploits and blunders (though he never makes the same mistake twice). He seems a careless clown at first glance, but is in fact a shrewd man. Having lived in Langran's Troia province until about age ten, he speaks with a Troia accent.

P_0x00233B.en: Leader of a Shutedonias special ops platoon, ranked major - high for the post, as his elite unit handles many vital missions. A consummate career soldier through and through.

P_0x0025A0.en: UA Shutedonias officer; a former attache to Langran with wide connections.

P_0x00262F.en: Ex-Shutedonias garrison captain, now boss of a bandit gang (they claim to be guerrillas). Falsely suspected over his Langran-born wife, he deserted; when she died of illness he despaired and turned bandit. A cultured man, he talks rough to avoid being taken lightly.

U_0x005EA9.en: White Tiger of the Four Gods, a <Chokijin>. Even alone, KoOhKi excels at high-speed ground combat. Blackened and serving Baral against Bullet, it now rivals its psychic-piloted power.
